words.example: HR will issue the holiday circular on Monday morning.
words.exampleZh: 人力资源部周一上午印发假期传阅文件。

words.example: The director will announce the new clinic hours at the town hall.
words.exampleZh: 主任会在全员大会上宣布新的门诊时间。

words.example: Who will communicate the room change to people already traveling?
words.exampleZh: 已经在路上的人，房间变更由谁去沟通？

words.example: We can discuss the intern's rotation at your one-on-one.
words.exampleZh: 实习生的轮岗可以在你的一对一面谈里讨论。

words.example: Did anyone consult the night shift before changing the handover time?
words.exampleZh: 改交接时间之前，有没有征询过夜班？

words.example: Only the two on-call engineers may use sudo on the interface host.
words.exampleZh: 只有两位待命工程师可以在接口主机上使用提权命令。

words.example: The root account on the PACS host was used outside the agreed window.
words.exampleZh: 影像主机的超级管理员在约定的窗口之外被使用了。

words.example: The service restart cleared the stuck jobs inside the print spooler.
words.exampleZh: 这次服务重启清掉了打印队列服务里卡住的任务。

words.example: A graceful restart of the order service kept the open sessions alive.
words.exampleZh: 医嘱服务做了一次平滑重启，已经打开的会话还在。

words.example: The hard reboot of the file server cut off three people who were saving.
words.exampleZh: 文件服务器的强制重启切断了三个人正在进行的保存。
